rows.answer: Cats and dogs are the only pets permitted to be carried in the cabin on Etihad Airways flights [1][5].
Guests must be at least 18 years of age to be eligible to transport a pet in the cabin [3][4].

Yes, you can take your dog in the cabin of First class, provided it meets the requirements for pets in cabin (PETC). The pet must be in a container that complies with the maximum weight and dimension requirements, and the combined weight of the pet and container must not exceed 8 kg. Additionally, the pet must be able to sit, stand, and lie down comfortably in the container, which must be ventilated on at least three surfaces [2][5].
On an A321LR flight, a maximum of 4 pets (cats or dogs) are allowed in the Economy cabin. Pets are not permitted in the First or Business cabins on this aircraft type [1][2][3].
